spans.s: रक् (1) tad.affix र proposed by the Var- ttikakra instead of अारक् for being affixed to the word गोधा to form the word गौधारः: cf. आरग्वचनमनर्थकं रका सिद्धत्वात्
; (2) krt affix रक् applied to the root ज्या; cf. रकेि ज्यः प्रसारणम्

रक्त lit. coloured i.e.coloured by nasalization: a term used by ancient grammarians for a nasa- Iized letter ( अनुनासिक ); cf रक्तसंज्ञो नुनासेकः R.Pr.r.17on which Uvvata comments :-- अनुनासिको वणो . रक्त इत्युच्यते; also cf. अरक्तसंध्येत्यपवाद्यते पदं R. Pr,
, where unnasa- lized अा is stated as अरक्तसंधि and illustrated by the commentator by quoting the passage मन्द्रमा- वरेण्यम् as contrasted with अभ्र औ अषः ।
रक्तपाद conventional name given to the second pada of the fourth Adhyaya of Paini's Astadhyayi as the Pada begins with the Sutra तेन रक्तं रागात्

रक्षित named मैत्रेयरक्षित or मैत्रेय also; a famous grammarian of the Eastern school of grammarians which flourished in Bihar and Bengal in the ninth, tenth, eleventh and twelfth centuries, claiming मैत्रयरक्षित, पुरुषोत्तमदेव, सीरदेव and others as pro- minent grammar scholars among others. See the word मैत्रेयरक्षिiत.
